case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your proposal; we value our long-standing relationship and are willing to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms. However, the prices you suggested are not feasible for us. We can offer €51.60 per unit under these extended terms. 

Our current proposal stands at a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. Our team at the foundry takes immense pride in our craft, and we are glad to continue our cooperation with your esteemed company on these mutually sound conditions.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your revised proposal. We note your slight adjustment, but we are still far apart. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We have already made a significant concession in our last offer, but we are willing to make another step to €51.50 per unit. Our latest proposal offers a price of €51.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This quotation remains valid for 30 days.

We ask you to review your numbers, as a good relationship requires realistic steps from both sides. Our foundry has valued the partnership between Demo Gießerei GmbH and Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over many years, and we believe that mutual fairness is the true foundation of our shared success in the region.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
